items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: do you remember Kenny Baker, the British trumpet player?

ctx.x: Yeah. I understand that you also have a role sometimes that you don’t really enjoy and that’s writing obituaries for people that are still with us? © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

Yeah. Well I’m an obituary writer for “The Guardian” which is a national newspaper. And as often the case, one is writing obituaries ahead of time. It’s a peculiar feeling. I also find it creatively quite hard to do because somehow, you know if I ring the paper, I mean do you remember Kenny Baker, the British trumpet player?
